title: Progression tuning
description: In-match progression owned by the Economy domain (Economy & Progression Bible §1, §9, §16). VeyraEconomy binds it to FVeyraProgressionTuning, and also checks that the XP curve has one entry per level below the cap and that each ultimate rank has one rising opening level.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's format. A build reads exactly one version.

skillPointsPerLevel.description: Skill points gained at level 1 and at each level after it. Canon (§1, §9): one.

basicAbilityMaxRank.description: The top rank of Q, W and E, which have no level gate. Canon (§1): 5.

ultimateMaxRank.description: The top rank of R. Canon (§1): 3.

ultimateRankLevels.description: The level at which each ultimate rank opens, one per rank, rising. Canon (§1): 6, 11 and 16.

experience.description: The shared XP curve (§9: one data-driven XP-to-level curve for every Vanguard).

provenance.description: Where these values come from (ADR-008 §7). Canon gives no curve, so it was drafted for playtesting.

toNextLevel.description: XP to go from each level to the next, starting at level 1: one entry per level below maxLevel. XP past the cap is discarded.
